📝 Walkthrough

Walkthrough

The change adds authenticated, user-scoped note CRUD operations to the backend and connects them to a frontend dashboard. The dashboard supports loading, creating, editing, deleting, empty states, error states, modal forms, and responsive styling.

Changes

Notes feature

Layer / File(s) Summary
Note data and service operations
backend/src/models/Note.js, backend/src/models/index.js, backend/src/services/note.service.js, backend/src/server.js		 Added the Note model, User associations, and user-scoped note persistence operations.
Authenticated note API
backend/src/routes/note.routes.js, backend/src/controllers/note.controller.js, backend/src/utils/sanitize.js, backend/src/app.js, backend/package.json		 Added authenticated note endpoints, controllers, and note-content sanitization support.
Dashboard note workflow
frontend/src/services/notes.service.ts, frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx, frontend/package.json		 Added typed note API methods, rich-text editing, and dashboard state for loading, creating, editing, and deleting notes.
Dashboard presentation and project support
frontend/src/index.css, frontend/src/pages/Login.tsx, .gitignore		 Added responsive dashboard, card, modal, loading, empty-state, and button styles. Updated the login placeholder and ignore rules.

Estimated code review effort: 4 (Complex) | ~45 minutes

Mergeability Score: 🔵 Low · up to ebcb1

The PR adds note creation, editing, and rich-content display, but the current version still has stylesheet lint violations, persists note HTML without applying the new sanitizer, hides notes after deletion failures, and lacks basic modal accessibility behavior. The PR is mergeable only with explicit owner awareness and follow-up on these bounded issues.

Sequence Diagram(s)

Loading 
sequenceDiagram
  participant User
  participant Dashboard
  participant NotesService
  participant NoteRoutes
  participant NoteService
  participant NoteModel
  User->>Dashboard: create, edit, or delete note
  Dashboard->>NotesService: invoke note operation
  NotesService->>NoteRoutes: send authenticated request
  NoteRoutes->>NoteService: dispatch operation with user ID
  NoteService->>NoteModel: persist or remove user-owned note
  NoteModel-->>NoteService: return operation result
  NoteService-->>NoteRoutes: return service result
  NoteRoutes-->>NotesService: return API response
  NotesService-->>Dashboard: update note state

Implement accessible modal dialog behavior.

The modal is only a div overlay. It has no dialog role, no accessible name, no focus management, and no Escape-key handling. Keyboard and assistive-technology users can still interact with background controls.

Use an accessible dialog implementation. Move focus into the modal, restore focus on close, constrain focus while open, and add an aria-label to the icon-only close button.

As per path instructions, check React component structure.
